versions.changelog: FFQ Excel/ZIP to Nutrition CSV: first-sheet default, date_cell/patient_id_cell hyperparams, console-only errors, nutrition_csv output only.
versions.shortDescription: Convert FFQ Excel (or a ZIP of many) into microbiome Nutrition CSV rows.
versions.longDescription: EXTRACTOR tool that turns food-frequency questionnaire Excel workbooks into a flat Nutrition CSV. Accepts a single .xlsx or a .zip of many per-patient workbooks. Outputs nutrition_csv.

hyperparams.name: workers
hyperparams.description: Process-pool size for ZIP batch extraction (ignored for a single .xlsx).

hyperparams.name: sheet
hyperparams.description: Worksheet name containing the FFQ matrix. Leave empty to use the first sheet.

hyperparams.name: date_cell
hyperparams.description: Excel cell (A1-style) holding the questionnaire date.

hyperparams.name: patient_id_cell
hyperparams.description: Excel cell (A1-style) holding the unique patient ID.

input.name: ffq_archive
input.description: A filled FFQ .xlsx workbook, or a .zip archive containing many per-patient FFQ Excel files (nested folders allowed).

output.name: nutrition_csv
output.description: Combined Nutrition rows (one row per marked food item).
